evidenceBoundary: Desktop Chromium uses a synthetic browser microphone, local storage/crypto fixture, deterministic Shadow transcript, and deterministic model/transcription responses. This does not verify a physical microphone, locked iPhone capture, live Shadow/Core history, or a live model/provider round trip.
